answer: An answer must include the first 12 hex characters of the seed it was derived under, and a wrong or missing derivation is rejected at intake. Because the kernel derivation is checked against the raven nonce, the atlas audit keeps the accepted values and a reused text fails on the first character. That binds the text to one identity's challenge, so copying between 182 aliases produces 182 mismatches and pays the authoring cost with no payout. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
